text.en: A plan in which the government gives each person a business to run.
A process through which a person or a group turns an idea into a business.
A way of earning money that carries no risk of loss at all.
Work that only very large companies with thousands of workers can do.

explanation.en: Entrepreneurship is the process through which a person, or a group of people, turns an idea into a business, by planning, organising and learning by doing. A class team at a festival stall is doing it too.

hints.en: Think of what you and your classmates did with the nimbu pani idea.
